g_ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

f_ir.name: advantage_normalized_sigmoid_tanh_margin_loss
f_ir.intuition: Repaired to reduce similarity by replacing the exponential margin with a tanh-based adaptive margin computed from the mean advantage gap's norm. This uses tanh to softly saturate the margin and maintain numeric stability without exponential scaling, differentiating the approach while preserving normalization and smooth nonlinear scaling. Also removed direct norm of raw advantage_gap and instead normalizes by mean norm of advantage_gap's absolute values. This fixes novelty failure by changing the margin formulation and mitigating potential numerical instability from large exponentials.
f_ir.pseudocode:
epsilon=1e-6
mean_abs_adv = mean(abs(advantage_gap))
margin = tanh(clamp(mean_abs_adv, 0, 1))
norm = max(mean(abs(advantage_gap)), epsilon)
x_raw = (log_prob_w - log_prob_l) / norm
x = margin * x_raw
x = clamp(x, -20, 20)
loss = -logsigmoid(x)
loss_weighted = loss * weight
return sum(loss_weighted) / max(sum(weight), epsilon)
f_ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch['weight']
    advantage_gap = batch['advantage_gap']
    epsilon = 1e-6
    mean_abs_adv = ops.mean(ops.abs(advantage_gap))
    margin = ops.tanh(ops.clamp(mean_abs_adv, 0.0, 1.0))
    norm = ops.maximum(mean_abs_adv, epsilon)
    x_raw = ops.div(ops.sub(lpw, lpl), norm)
    x = ops.mul(margin, x_raw)
    x = ops.clamp(x, -20.0, 20.0)
    loss = ops.neg(ops.logsigmoid(x))
    loss_weighted = ops.mul(loss, weight)
    loss_mean = ops.div(ops.sum(loss_weighted), ops.maximum(ops.sum(weight), epsilon))
    return loss_mean
